intro.author: Paul, according to the letter (1:1). Traditionally accepted as Paul's; many modern scholars think it was written by a later follower in his name, while others defend Paul's authorship.
intro.written: If by Paul, about AD 64–67, from prison in Rome; traditionally his last letter before his death
intro.audience: Timothy, Paul's closest coworker, probably still in Ephesus
intro.setting: Paul is in chains again (1:16) and expects to die soon (4:6). Many in Asia had turned away from him (1:15), and only Luke remains with him (4:11). He urges Timothy to come quickly, before winter, bringing Mark, his cloak and his books (4:9-13, 21). Early Christian tradition holds that Paul was executed in Rome under Emperor Nero.
intro.purpose: Paul writes a farewell charge urging Timothy to be strong, to guard and pass on the gospel, to endure suffering, and to keep preaching the word.
intro.bigIdea: Guard the gospel and endure hardship, because the Lord stays faithful to the end.

outline.title: Strong in grace, a faithful worker
Hard times and the sure Scriptures
